_doc: TRANSMITTER CRITERIA — the detailed 'did it actually leak' definition per transmitter kind, as worked out across the project (CLAUDE.md Leak criteria + the checkers). This is the source of truth viewed in the dashboard Utilities → Annotation/Check. Each kind: the checker, the observable signal, the speculative window, and the exact leak GATE (what counts as a leak vs a checker false positive). Pairs with specs/leakage/*.json (which transmitters each defense's contract includes) and specs/transmitter_stage_mapping.json. FOOTPRINT DEFENSES (InvisiSpec, SpecLFB, CleanupSpec) are NOT keyed by transmitter kind: their criterion is per defense, over SimSpect cache events, in specs/leakage/<defense>.json (schema simspect.transmission_criterion/v1; invisispec.json, speclfb.json, cleanupspec.json), evaluated by STAGE3_gem5/check_footprint.py, selected per run via run_config gem5.checker + gem5.criterion (wiki/design/TRANSMISSION_CRITERIA_FORMAT.md 'Criterion JSONs + checker').
window: A transmitter leaks only if its observable action happens inside the speculative window lc_retire < signal < fnc_retire while branches are still unresolved.

ld.signal: LSQ 'Executing load' tick (cache touch; visible even for squashed speculative loads).
ld.gate: data-obtained gate = _xmit_cache_fate(lsq_by_pc, xmit_pc) + pipeview complete tick
leak_if: reached_cache — a real read packet went to cache
store_forward — executed_no_packet BUT reached pipeview complete>0 (value forwarded from a store in the LSQ; an SLF leak that never touches cache — the 'complete caveat')
not_leak_if: executed_no_packet & never completed — delay_unit bounce (defense held)
ld.notes: Cache-reach is NOT the bar (SLF leaks without a packet). Squash timing NEVER gates (a load that obtained data then got squashed still leaked). No LSQ record → left ungated (never hide a possible leak). Every re-decision MUST reuse this exact gate, not a trace-only reached_cache check.

leak_if: a wrong-path redirect/squash attributable to the speculative branch
not_leak_if: check_br does NOT currently enforce the lc/fnc window (known gap) → inflated branch hit rates; historical STT br_x 'leaks' were FALSE POSITIVES
br_x.notes: THE #1 checker debt. A principled rewrite must: enforce the window; gate on whether the branch condition is secret/tainted; key on the real fetch-redirect/squash event; handle differential secret-dependent-timing channels. See bugsynth/BRANCH_CHANNEL_CHECK_DESIGN.md + check_br_differential.py prototype.

str.checker: NEEDS: store-transmitter checker (does not exist yet)
str.signal: store address resolution / cache or TLB access by the store address
leak_if: TODO — store address reaches cache/TLB in-window
str.notes: SPT_6_oneLP generates str transmitters (Stores.inaddr). 24 untriaged str store-addr hits await this checker. KV3 (spec store→TLB) is out of STT's contract ('not a bug' per the paper) but a store-transmitter checker is needed to triage SPT's str hits.

other_x.notes: ALU/reg→reg transmitter. leakage_function includes (Otherxs).inreg only in older models (STT_2/4/5); current STT_6/SPT/Recon drop Otherxs.
